verdict.rationale: Bolna builds voice agents that use tools, so letting those agents consume external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only documents Bolna's own MCP server, which lets outside AI clients connect to a Bolna account. That is the server role and does not count here. Nothing shows Bolna agents connecting to third-party MCP servers; the Tools tab and Integrations page mention only built-in tools and provider connections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
